C1384.title: Firmware Backdoor Implantation in the Lebanon Pager Explosion Incident
C1384.summary: On September 17, 2024, thousands of pagers used by Hezbollah members exploded across Lebanon, killing 12 people and injuring nearly 3,000 in the first wave; walkie-talkie explosions followed the next day. Reporting and expert analysis indicated that explosives may have been inserted during production or distribution and triggered by received signals, demonstrating how communications-device supply-chain tampering can cause direct physical casualties.
